## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `0fd8e1969f2d02dc5568987a978673be40549eb8`
Local-runs: none

Inputs read: card #20969 (body; comments `5921874538`, `5922653696`, `5923104992`, `5923148779`); PR #20961 (merged as `315888d660`, its diff `75519e1c0a...d9d0d38cfc` read with `git diff`); PR #21016 body, file list, and the net diff against `main` (merge base `a5bce40888`: one file, `scripts/pm/check-widening-tells.mjs`, +431/-10); the head tree via `git show` / `git grep` / `git log`; the head's check-runs, read last.

### ① Derived judgments

**Accept-set / public-surface changes the diff implies: none.** The one file is a root-private script (`package.json` is `private: true`, no package's `files` names `scripts/`), so no published package's accept set or public surface moves. What moves is one PM enqueue gate's verdict on one diff shape. Named right.

**The repair, walked in the head tree — right.**
- Removed side (`tellsInFile`): a `T1` line that `declaresUnwritableKey` reads certain (`- body: retiredKey(`) now records its key in a per-block `retired` map and then `continue`s — it still reaches no `budget.set`, so a removed tombstone still buys no T1 unit. #17955's un-retiring invariant holds by construction and is pinned (`+ body: z.array(z.unknown()),` after the removal fires; the un-retiring-through-the-wrapper case fires in both closing spellings).
- Added side: the credit is spent only when `kind === 'T1'`, `localForms` is live, and `wrappedTombstoneKey` names a key: the regex is `KEY_HEAD_SOURCE` + one name from `localForms.transparent` + `(` + a shared unwritable form (`retiredKey(`, `retirementTombstone(`, `handlerKeyRefusal(`, `aliasKeyRefusal(` — each pattern provably ends at its own paren, `closingAtItsOwnParen`). `readToCloser` then demands #18488's certainty: the tombstone call still open at end of line and lexable, or closed with only `)` and a comma after it (`REWRAPPED_TAIL`). A chained arm on the tombstone or on the wrapper, a wrapper tail carrying arguments, a second wrapper level, a live value inside the wrapper, and a comment all answer `null` and fall through to the ordinary budget — pinned, except the wrapper-tail-with-arguments case, which follows from `REWRAPPED_TAIL` but has no case of its own.
- The check sits after #17955's decline and before the #16943 budget, so a paid line spends no T1 unit owed to a live rename beside it — pinned in both orders. The credit is one-for-one and block-scoped (`changeBlocks`), pinned.
- The two live keys in PR #20961's own hunk (`children`, `footer` through `componentSlot(`) are paid by the existing budget, so THE FINDING fixture reads zero rows and `wideningRefusal` reads `clean`. The fixture is the PR #20961 hunk verbatim; I checked the hunk header `@@ -871,21 +919,29 @@` against the real diff and the `body:` line is new-file line 932 as stated.

**The transparency proof — sound for the shapes the brief names.** `transparentFactory` requires exactly one `definitionSites` hit, a `factoryReturnExpression` reading whose first parameter is a bare identifier, `returns` of 0 (an expression body) or 1, and `expr` matching `^first[ ]?(;|}|$)`. `returnCount` counts `return` at any depth and answers -1 for a body that never closes, so a second return in a braced branch, a return in a nested callback, and an unreadable body all refuse; a chained form (`schema.optional()`, `schema.or(...)`) fails on the `.`; a prefixed arm (`z.string().or(schema)`) fails at the first character; a later parameter, two definitions, and an absent definition refuse. `topLevelReturn` and `returnCount` lex strings and comments the same way, so a nested-only return reaches `null` before the count is consulted. The source is `readSource(file)` taken once in `localDeclaringForms` — the same head blob and the same pass as #18702's resolver, and a name the resolver never wanted (never on an added key line) is never on the list. Right.

**Pins and wiring — right.** 28 `t(` calls between `battery('#20969 …')` and the floor block, equal to the new `SELF_TEST_BATTERIES` entry (28); the roster is now 29 entries against `SELF_TEST_BATTERY_FLOOR = 16`; the sum of per-battery floors moves 510 to 538, the same +28 the stated 525 to 553 total moves. `keyedPropertyName` is split into `propertyNameOf` with its behaviour unchanged; `factoryReturnExpression` gains an additive `returns` field that `classifyFactoryReturn` and `resolveDeclaringFactory` ignore.

**The corpus claim — plausible from the method stated.** In this clone (shallow, boundary `2e8bd8322b`, the commit the PR names) `git rev-list --no-merges --count a5bce40888 -- packages/spec/src` is 1,979, the PR's figure exactly; with the boundary excluded and `.test.ts`/`.spec.ts` dropped, `--name-status` gives 1,933 commits, exactly the PR's figure, and 5,860 file diffs against the stated 5,865 (a rename-counting difference). The row counts (4,915 against 4,914, one moved row on `315888d660`) were not re-run — read-only — but the arithmetic closes (T1 2,390 + T2 2,040 + T4 484 = 4,914), and the first commit's census (1,932 commits, 0 differing, measured before `main` was merged) against the re-measure after `315888d660` entered the branch (+1 commit, +1 row on the base version) is internally consistent.

**Sentences tested against the tree.** True: "the thirteenth accidental variable" (twelve prior sections counted in the header); new-file line 932; blob `b2f88ca605` (the diff's index line); "the marker hands back the very instance" (`component.zod.ts:444-453` at `a5bce40888`); the shape's population on `packages/spec/src/**` is that one key line (a PCRE grep at `a5bce40888` finds only `component.zod.ts:932`); #17955's closing-line residual has population 0 (no `)).or(` closing line at `a5bce40888`); `main` never touched the script between `dfe5a0863f` and `a5bce40888` and `315888d660` is an ancestor of the merge point; `scripts/pm/**` ships in no package; `eslint.config.mjs` sets no `parserOptions.project`; `definitionSites` (`${name}\b`) and `localFormPattern` (`${n}\(`) interpolate the name unescaped while `wrappedTombstoneKey` and `transparentFactory` escape `$`; zero `$`-named top-of-line definitions under `packages/spec/src` at the head; the eight named transparent definitions exist at `a5bce40888` and each is `return param;` or an expression-bodied arrow whose body is its parameter, bare.

- **Over-broad (docblock, #20969 header): "8 of 6,388 top-of-line definitions read transparent (… `withRefusalConversions`), none of them mutating what it returns."** `withRefusalConversions` (`stack.zod.ts:3768`) calls `markRefusalConversions`, whose `stampConversionRecord` does `Object.defineProperty(target, STACK_CONVERSIONS, …)` on the very instance it hands back — one of the eight does mutate what it returns. It mutates an Error, never a schema, so the quiet direction the sentence bounds (a mutated tombstone read transparent) still has population 0; the sentence is true only narrowed to "none of them mutates a schema it returns". The 6,388 denominator was not re-measured. Does not move the verdict; it is a one-line docblock correction.
- **Incomplete (PR body, "The repair"): "Transparent means the definition has exactly one `return`, and that return is the bare first parameter."** The code and the docblock also accept an expression-bodied arrow that IS its parameter (zero returns; the `pass` case pins it). True as a sufficient condition, not the whole definition. True on `main` the moment this lands, as the docblock already states it.
- The before/after table, `--declaration yes` exit 0, the five ablation red sets and "553 cases pass" are the dev's measurements, not re-run here; each ablation names an anchor that exists in the diff, and nothing in the diff touches the T3 reading.
- The loud residuals the header keeps are right, and one it does not state: a wrapped tombstone whose key line changes while wrapped on BOTH sides (`- body: W(retiredKey(` / `+ body: W(retiredKey(`, say re-indented) fires, because the removed side is classified against `surfaces` without `localForms` (#18702's added-side-only asymmetry) and mints nothing. Loud direction, population 0 (the one wrapped line is unchanged since `315888d660`).

### ② Semver level

- No changeset, `skip-changeset` labelled — right: the diff publishes nothing from any released package (root `private: true`; `scripts/` in no `files`), and `Check Changeset` is skipped on the head for that label.
- `Clause-②: no (a PM enqueue gate's verdict changes; no published package's accept set or public surface moves, per the question in scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs)` — reads `declared`, value `no`, arm `null` under `readClause2Line`: the parenthetical opens with `a`, not an arm-family word, so `readArmToken` returns no arm and no `bad`, and the line is not malformed. Right on substance: 「本卡放宽接受集或扩大公开面吗」— nothing published widens, and nothing published narrows, so no `(narrowing)` arm is owed. The claim `5922653696` and the PR body carry the same line.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev report `5923104992`: no `deviations` field (none declared); `open_questions: []`; `out_of_scope_findings[0]` (the unescaped `$` in `definitionSites` / `localFormPattern`) — verified true in the tree, population 0 verified, and carried into the PR body's Acceptance notes as the seat ruling `5923148779` says. Answered.
- Flags in the summary: (a) the filing's mechanism corrected — confirmed by the code: the removed tombstone mints no T1 unit and `retiredComponentSlot(` is no shared unwritable form, so #17955's added-side decline cannot pay the line; (b) "whatever wraps the value" narrowed to wrappers the head blob proves transparent, with the overturn condition stated in the header — right, the loud direction; (c) NOT MEASURED `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` (container foreground cap) — CI's Lint & Repo Gates runs it (`lint.yml:1024`) and is success on this head: answered; (d) attribution follows AGENTS.md over the harness reminder — the repo's own instruction files name AGENTS.md the source of truth; not a contract matter.
- Raised here, escalated to the seat, neither moving the verdict: (1) the over-broad "none of them mutating" census sentence above, a one-line docblock narrowing; (2) an unstated quiet direction beside the stated mutation case — a wrapper that REASSIGNS its first parameter before its one return (`schema = z.string(); return schema;`) passes `transparentFactory` exactly as a mutating body does, and a text reader could see this one; population 0 among the eight transparent definitions at `a5bce40888`, same overturn condition. (3) Nit: the floor-failure roster string drops a space ("STOPPED READING —the") and files the #20969 entry ahead of #19099's; no gate reads that string.
- Check-runs on `0fd8e1969f` (read last, 02:14Z, deduped by name on newest `started_at`): 31 names — 21 success, 10 skipped, 0 failure, none still running. Success: Lint & Repo Gates (carries `check:pm-widening-tells` and `check:pm-dispatch-gates`), Governed Surface Queue Guard, Test Core and its six shards, Type Check (workspace, source gates, debt ledger, consumer gates), TypeScript Type Check, Check Documentation Links, Dogfood Regression Gate, the three claim guards, filter. Skipped: Auto Label, Build Core, Build Docs, Check Changeset, Check PR Size, Console Pin Gate, the Dogfood matrix shards, Dogfood Verify CLI, Packed-tarball smoke, Temporal Conformance.
